Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: notes-snapshot-control-room
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides instructions and metadata for an AI agent to interact with a local tool called 'notesctl' for Apple Notes backups. The instructions in SKILL.md focus on maintaining the tool's 'local-first' identity and require the agent to perform environment verification using standard diagnostic commands (e.g., `./notesctl verify`, `./notesctl doctor`). No evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection was found.

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only guide that tells an operator/agent to run local notesctl preflight commands — it does not request secrets or install code. Before relying on it, verify that the notesctl binary it references is legitimate: check its provenance or source code and be cautious if you don't already have notesctl installed (running unknown local binaries can be risky). If you want the agent to actually run commands, ensure local tooling behaves as expected and that you trust any local token-gated APIs referenced in your environment.
